Explicit native reductions (all native-safe): (1) window.sessionStorage -> in-memory module Map keyed by SESSION_DISMISS_KEY; dismissal persists for the app process and resets on cold start (analogous to a closed-and-reopened tab) rather than via browser Web Storage. (2) lucide SVG icons -> monochrome unicode glyphs. (3) CSS sticky positioning, z-index and backdrop-blur are not portable to RN and are dropped; tone colours map to warning/accent token ramps. (4) aria role 'status' -> accessibilityRole 'summary'; data-mode -> accessibilityValue. (5) i18n comes from the local default-returning t with {{name}} interpolation (no react-i18next runtime in native parity).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports in the native output — only react, react-native, the native useAdmin hook, AppText, and theme tokens.
